greetings: Hail, traveler. The winds are cold, but my heart... is also cold.
Welcome to the tundra. By Odin's beard, buy something so I can buy firewood.
The All-Father brings you to my hall. Either that, or you're just very lost.
guild_master.reward: A meager sum, but enough for a horn of mead.

farmer: I planted potatoes yesterday. Today, I harvest ice cubes.
The All-Father demands blood, but all I have is this frozen beetroot.
My hoe broke on the permafrost. Again. For the ninth time today.
I tried to sacrifice a carrot to Freyja. It bounced off the altar.
You call this farming? I call it chiseling the earth.
We do not sow. Wait, no, we do sow. It just doesn't grow.
Behold! The singular grain of wheat I grew this year. It is magnificent.
A true warrior fights the earth itself for sustenance.
Sometimes I dream of a warm place. Then I wake up and punch a glacier.
Buy my crops, traveler, before I use them as blunt weapons.
fisherman: I caught a fish! And it shattered into pieces when I dropped it.
They say Jormungandr sleeps in these waters. I'm just looking for a cod.
My line is frozen. My bait is frozen. I am frozen. Is this Valhalla?
The sea gives, and the sea takes. Mostly it just takes feeling from my toes.
I used a frozen salmon as a club during the last pillager raid. It was effective.
Ice fishing is 90% contemplating your mortality and 10% pulling up an empty hook.
A kraken owes me five emeralds. Have you seen it?
I drink mead to stay warm. I fish to buy mead. It is the circle of life.
This ice hole is my only friend. I call him Bjorn.
The waters here are colder than a Draugr's embrace.
shepherd: My sheep are essentially walking snowballs at this point.
I tried to shear a sheep, but the wool was frozen solid. Now it has a stylish ice-fade.
Do you have any idea how hard it is to knit a sweater with frostbitten fingers?
The wolves here are fearsome, but my sheep have developed armor-plating from ice.
Freyja blesses my flock. And by blesses, I mean she lets them freeze slightly less.
A sheared sheep in this weather is a crime against nature and the gods.
I trade in wool, the only thing keeping us from becoming popsicles.
The sheep are looking at me with murderous intent. I think they want my mead.
One day I will ride a giant ram into battle. For now, I just feed them.
Dyeing wool is easy. I just use the blood of my enemies. Or, you know, beetroot.
fletcher: A well-crafted arrow flies straight. A frozen arrow shatters on impact.
I am carving a bow from the World Tree itself. Just kidding, it's spruce.
My arrows will blot out the sun! Not that we see much of it anyway.
Feathers are hard to come by when all the birds have frozen mid-flight.
May your aim be as true as Odin's spear, Gungnir.
I tried shooting a flaming arrow, but the cold put it out before it hit the target.
Need arrows? Or just very sharp, pointy icicles?
Fletching is an art. An art that requires you to not shiver while doing it.
The wind here laughs at archery. It literally mocks my arrows.
Buy a bow, or face the tundra unarmed. Your choice, weakling.
cleric: The All-Father sees all, but even he squints in a blizzard.
I brew potions of fire resistance, mostly just to drink them and stay warm.
The gods are angry today. Or maybe it's just Tuesday in the tundra.
I will cleanse you of your sins! And also your frostbite, for five emeralds.
Valhalla awaits the brave. A cozy bed awaits the smart.
Do not anger Thor, unless you enjoy being struck by lightning while freezing to death.
My brewing stand is frozen to the floor. Please send help.
I commune with the spirits. They mostly complain about the weather.
A potion of healing won't fix your terrible fashion sense, outlander.
We pray to the gods of warmth. They have left us on read.
weaponsmith: A frozen blade cuts deep, but a frozen hand drops the sword.
I quench my blades in the snow. It saves time and water.
Buy an axe! Perfect for chopping wood, or the skulls of your enemies.
The forge fire is the only thing keeping me alive. Do not stand in my light.
A sword of iron, forged in ice. It's an oxymoron, but it kills just the same.
My hammers sing the song of the Valkyries.
I once forged a sword so sharp it cut the winter wind in half. Probably.
You need a weapon, traveler. The snow hides many teeth.
A true warrior needs a heavy weapon. It keeps you warm from the exertion.
Blood freezes quickly on steel. Remember to wipe your blade, amateur.
armorer: Chainmail in this weather? Are you suicidal, or just stupid?
I line the armor with fur. Not for comfort, but to prevent your skin from peeling off.
An iron helmet is basically an ice bucket challenge you wear all day.
I forge shields sturdy enough to block a troll's club and the biting wind.
If you lick your iron chestplate right now, your tongue will stick to it. I dare you.
My armor protects the body. Nothing protects the soul from the cold.
A heavy breastplate makes it harder to run away from ice bears. Think about it.
I wear a helmet to bed. You never know when the roof might cave in from snow.
The All-Father protects, but a good iron pauldron doesn't hurt either.
Buy armor. Die slightly slower in the frozen wastes.
toolsmith: A pickaxe that can't break ice is just a funny-shaped hammer.
My shovels are legendary. They have cleared three feet of snow today alone.
I made a hoe once. I immediately melted it down in shame.
Mining in the frozen depths builds character. And hypothermia.
The bedrock is cold, but the surface is colder. Just keep digging.
I trade in tools of survival. Without my axes, you are firewood.
The dwarves of Svartalfheim have nothing on my ironwork!
A good tool is an extension of your arm. Which is currently numb.
Don't hit a glacier with an iron pick. The glacier wins.
Buy a shovel and dig your own grave, or dig a snow fort. Up to you.
butcher: The meat is fresh! And by fresh, I mean it's been frozen solid since last winter.
I don't need a cleaver, I just shatter the beef with a hammer.
Polar bear flank is tough, but it puts hair on your chest.
Would you like a side of ice with your frozen porkchop?
The gods demand a blood sacrifice. The best I can do is a frozen chicken.
Hacking meat in the cold keeps the blood from spraying everywhere. Very convenient.
I once fought a walrus for a prime cut of blubber. I won.
Meat is meat. Frozen meat is just meat that takes longer to chew.
We don't smoke meat here. We just let the winter wind slowly dehydrate it.
Buy some beef, traveler. Or I will feed you to the wolves.
leatherworker: Thick pelts are the only thing separating us from Helheim.
I sewed a leather tunic yesterday. Today it is as stiff as a board.
Nothing says 'I survived the tundra' like a cape made of rabbit fur.
I use the bones of my enemies for needles. Just kidding, I use bone meal.
Leather pants in the snow? Bold fashion choice. Enjoy the frostbite.
My saddles are crafted to withstand the harshest blizzards. And angry horses.
A good pair of leather boots is worth more than a chest of gold up here.
I dream of working with soft silk. But the gods gave me tough leather.
Freyja's chariot is pulled by cats. I could make a great hat out of... never mind.
Buy a pelt, before the winter wind claims your soul.
mason: Stone is strong. Ice is strong. But mostly, they are both just very cold.
I carve statues of the gods, but they usually just look like lumpy snowmen.
Laying bricks in a blizzard is a test of faith and stupidity.
The mortar freezes before I can even place the stone. It is deeply frustrating.
I am building a grand hall! We will drink mead and sing songs of warmth.
A stone wall keeps the wind out. And the Draugr. Mostly the wind.
My chisel broke. My hands are numb. Is it time for mead yet?
I tried to build an igloo, but my pride as a stonemason wouldn't allow it.
The mountains are my canvas. The pickaxe is my brush.
Buy some polished diorite. It looks like snow, but harder.
cartographer: Here is my map of the region. It's just a blank sheet of white paper.
The compass points north, but everything looks the same up here.
I mapped the fjords. It cost me three toes, but it's a very accurate map.
Beware the edges of the map. That's where the ice dragons live.
A map won't save you if you can't see past your own nose in a blizzard.
I chart the stars when the clouds break. Which is basically never.
My ink keeps freezing in the bottle. I'm considering using blood.
To explore the unknown is to embrace the cold embrace of death. Want a map?
I've marked the locations of all known mead halls. You're welcome.
Navigating the tundra is easy. Just walk until you stop feeling your legs.
librarian: The sagas tell of a time when the sun actually provided warmth.
My books are frozen shut. You'll have to thaw them before reading.
Knowledge is power! But it makes terrible kindling.
I read a book on pyromancy just to feel warm inside.
The runes hold ancient secrets. Mostly soup recipes, but still ancient.
Shh! The library is a place of quiet contemplation and quiet shivering.
A well-read mind is a sharp mind. Too bad my brain is currently frozen.
I have a first edition saga of Beowulf. It has coffee—I mean, mead stains on it.
Reading by candlelight is romantic, until the wind blows the candle out.
Buy a book, traveler. They make excellent insulation.
nitwit: I licked the iron golem. Now my tongue is stuck. Mmmph.
Everyone says 'prepare for winter', but I am busy preparing for a nap.
I tried to build a snowman, but I used gravel. It's very depressing.
I am the village idiot, but at least I'm not the one trying to farm in the snow.
They told me to go fight the pillagers. I hid in a snowdrift instead.
Mead makes the world go round! And round... and round... I feel sick.
I lost my shoes in the snow yesterday. I am currently wearing loaves of bread.
The All-Father gave me one brain cell, and it's currently focused on shivering.
I think the snow is made of sugar. Nope, just cold dirt.
I'm not lazy, I'm just conserving body heat. It's tactical.
none: I am unburdened by a profession. Also unburdened by emeralds.
I want to be a Viking, but my mom says I have to clean my room first.
I stand in the snow all day, waiting for purpose. Or a hot meal.
Do you think the village needs a professional snow-eater? Because I'm qualified.
The gods have no plan for me. So I just complain about the weather.
I don't have a job, but I do have a very impressive icicle collection.
Maybe one day I'll be a great Jarl. Today, I'm just freezing.
I'm considering a career in mead-tasting. It's a highly competitive field.
I have no skills, but I can shiver faster than anyone in the village.
Spare an emerald for a villager with no direction in life?

generic: By Odin's beard, it is cold today.
May your hearth be warm and your mead horn full.
I saw a Draugr last night. Or maybe it was just Lars stumbling home from the tavern.
The wind howls like Fenrir escaping his chains.
You look like you haven't seen a vegetable in months. Neither have we.
Keep your axe sharp and your wits sharper. The tundra forgives nothing.
Hail, traveler! Wipe the snow off your boots before you step on my dirt floor.
We are born in the ice, we live in the ice, and we complain about the ice.
The All-Father smiles upon those who bring mead. Got any?
Another blizzard is coming. Time to huddle together and share body heat. No weird stuff.

greetings: Hail! I'm training to be a Berserker, but mom says I have to wear my earmuffs first.
When I grow up, I'm going to raid the warm lands and steal all their cozy blankets!
I challenged a polar bear to a duel. He won by sitting on me.
Behold my mighty longship! It's a hollowed-out log in a frozen puddle, but fear it!
The All-Father demands I eat my beetroot... but I think Loki made it.
If you lick a frozen iron sword, Odin gives you double strength! Want to try?
I'm practicing my battle cry! WARGGHH! ...Did I scare you, outlander?
My dad says if I chop enough firewood, Thor will grant me a giant axe!
Look at my snow castle! It has three lookout towers and a moat of slush!
I tried to sacrifice a snowball to Freyja. It melted near the fire.
Are you a brave warrior or just another traveler who forgot their heavy coat?
Skál, traveler! Well, skál with goat milk, because papa won't let me touch the mead.
I'm building an army of snow golems to conquer the next village over!
My boots are packed with snow, which means I'm walking on pure frost power!
Did you bring any sweet rolls from the south? The permafrost ruined mine!
I carved runes into this stick! It says 'Big Warrior'... or 'Soup', I get them confused.
The wind is howling like Fenrir! I'm howling back so he knows who's boss!
I challenged my brother to a snow wrestling match. We're both stuck in a drift now.
Mama says I have the heart of a dragon and the nose of a runny reindeer.
If I stand really still, the frost giants won't see me. Shh!
Do you think Valhalla has hot chocolate? It better have hot chocolate.
I'm going to sail across the ocean as soon as I figure out how to untie this knot.
I dropped my axe in a snowbank and now it belongs to the snow gods.
Thor's hammer makes the thunder, but my tummy makes the exact same sound when I'm hungry!
My uncle died in battle, so now he gets free endless mead in Valhalla! I'm so jealous!
If the winter gets any colder, we might have to eat the sled dogs... again.
I lost two toes to frostbite, but that just makes me lighter for quick battle charges!
Grandpa says he's going on a 'peaceful walk into the blizzard'. He's been gone three days!
I made a wooden shield to protect me from pillagers! ...And from papa's stern discipline.
We buried my pet goat in the ice. On the bright side, he stays fresh forever!

cookie_success: By Odin's beard! A cookie! I will write a glorious saga about your generosity!
A sweet treat! This gives me +10 Strength against frost giants!
May Thor bless your path, traveler! This cookie is sweeter than honeyed mead!
cookie_fail_1: A cookie? Are you trying to poison me like Loki poisoned Baldur?!
Bah! Real Viking warriors eat frozen seal blubber, not crumbly bread!
Is this oatmeal raisin? This is an insult worthy of a blood feud!
cookie_fail_2: My dentist—I mean, the village witch—says sugar thins the blood against the frost.
No thanks. Last time I ate a cookie in the cold, my teeth froze together.
I'm on a strict berserker diet! Protein and rage only!
sugar_rush: RAAAAGHHH! THE SUGAR OF THE GODS FLOWS THROUGH MY VEINS! I CAN FIGHT AN ICE BEAR!
I HAVE THE POWER OF A THOUSAND SUNS! WATCH ME RUN CIRCLES AROUND THE LONGSHIP!
VALHALLA CAN WAIT! I MUST RUN THROUGH THE BLIZZARD AT MAXIMUM SPEED!
sugar_fail: Ugh... my tummy feels like a troll is stomping inside it...
The sugar crash is heavier than a fallen glacier... I must rest...
I feel weak... the winter chill is returning to my soul... need nap...
toy_success: A carved wooden axe! Now I can raid the neighbor's cabbage patch in style!
A toy longship! I shall sail it in the washing tub until it sinks in glory!
By the gods! A genuine wooden shield! I am now ready for the shield wall!
toy_fail: What is this trash? You can't even slay a single goblin with this!
A stuffed sheep? Do I look like a coward who sleeps with soft things?!
This toy broke the second it hit the permafrost. Your blacksmith is weak!
parents: Papa is out hunting dire wolves, and Mama is sharpening her battleaxe for fun.
My parents told me if I don't finish my stew, the Draugr will drag me away!
Mom said if I raid the pantry one more time, she's sending me on a lone voyage to Ireland.
rps_win: HA! Rock smashes your scissors! Odin smiles upon my tactical genius!
VICTORY! My choice cut through yours like an axe through a wooden door!
I WIN! Claiming victory in rock-paper-scissors is the first step to becoming Jarl!
rps_lose: DEFEAT?! This is treachery! You must have used dark runic magic!
No! My hand froze at the last second! That doesn't count!
A true warrior learns from defeat... prepare yourself for a rematch in Valhalla!
rps_tie: A tie! Our battle will be spoken of in the sagas for generations!
Both choices fell at the same moment! An honorable stalemate!
Neither of us backs down! Truly, a clash of two mighty warlords!
